title: Velcro window blind
text: Velcro window blind. Ok... 4 stars for easy, no hassle install....  ZERO stars for the length.  So that puts it in at 2 1/2 or 3 stars tops.  My window is 63" long.  I think they are counting the valance type flap at the top that hides the velcro for the straps that hold the blind up in their 68" statement.  I wish it were 68" long - as many others have reported.  It will still work... but it looks really cheap because the bottom of the window still shows.  Eh.  Just be aware they are no where CLOSE to 68" long. I enclosed a pic... also... even though I got out my steam presser, it could not get all the creases and folds out.  Eh. I am thinking about what I could add to the bottom to make it look less... awkward.  Anyway.. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I hope my pic and info were helpful to you!
